claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Quinelorane is a dopamine D2/D3 receptor agonist with no known cytotoxic mechanism; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive in a 5-day pooled viability screen, with any weak antiproliferative signal attributable to non-specific dopamine-receptor-independent effects rather than a defined cytotoxic class.
